trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show generic rights to change terms or prices, with no evidence about the $89 lifetime deal itself or that deal buyers were charged more.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right, in our sole discretion, to make changes or modifications to these Terms of Use at any time and for any reason.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can unilaterally change terms at any time, undermining guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We may change prices at any time. All payments shall be in U.S. dollars.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to change prices anytime, undermining fixed $89 lifetime price.

trials.claimQuote: Sell digital products and subscriptions with zero commissions using high-converting sales funnels
trials.reasoning: The vendor promises forever 0% commissions and a buyer confirms zero commissions in use; Stripe or PayPal processing fees are separate from Zylvie charging a commission.

exhibits.quote: Your customer's funds flow directly from your customer to your own Stripe or PayPal account, so there's no waiting time or payout threshold.
exhibits.argument: Payments still go through Stripe or PayPal which charge their own processing fees, so zero commissions is misleading.

exhibits.quote: We currently support both Stripe and PayPal for payment processing and payouts.
exhibits.argument: Requiring Stripe and PayPal for processing means third-party transaction fees still apply despite zero-commission claim.

exhibits.quote:
- Forever-0% commissions

- No sales limit whatsoever

- 5 brands/stores
exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing promises forever zero percent commissions with no sales limit.

exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Zylvie delivers zero commissions in real use.
